result.document_summary: Part 6 of 7 of Newark's municipal code chapter on city housing programs: homeowner loan-forgiveness programs (closing costs, facade improvement), an employee ownership loan program, and the start of an affordable housing deed restriction section on City-owned property sales.
result.notes: This part contains no rules in the six in-scope categories. It covers homebuyer closing-cost loans, facade improvement loans, employee ownership loans and trusts, and the opening of an affordable housing deed restriction for City-owned property sales. None of these is rent control, just-cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting. The affordable housing deed restriction section (2:10-9) is cut off at its definitions and in any case concerns resale of City-owned property rather than a covered rule category.
